Resources

Compliance webinars

Recorded sessions on the rules that change most often, run by the advisors who handle them day to day.

Healthcare compliance webinars can save your company time and money while keeping everyone updated on the latest industry standards. At Healthcare Compliance Pros, we’ve compiled our list of helpful healthcare compliance webinars you can stream anytime. Browse through our available webinars and watch for free to learn more about HIPAA compliance, cybersecurity, OSHA compliance, and much more. At Healthcare Compliance Pros, we believe that training is one of the best ways to keep your company safe from additional liabilities that you might face. In addition to creating webinars for healthcare professionals, we’ve also created an easy-to-use online platform that helps you stay compliant in a minimal amount of time. Our services not only help your company stay HIPAA and OSHA-compliant, but they also offer a complete human resources program, learning management system, and live support. Explore our endless resources, including our healthcare compliance webinars and programs available for your business.

The Cybersecurity Ripple Effect: Shared Risk and Readiness in Healthcare.

Join our FREE online webinar as Nicole Statley explains how cybersecurity incidents like phishing, ransomware, vendor breaches, and system outages can impact ePHI, patient care, and healthcare operations. On October 21 at 1:30 PM MT , learn practical steps to strengthen HIPAA Security Rule compliance, improve incident response, and better prepare your organization before a cyber incident occurs.

If you give a website a Cookie, it will probably take your ePHI.

Join our FREE online webinar as HCP's Jake Yates breaks down how your healthcare website could be collecting and sharing more information than you realize. From cookies and pixels to analytics, advertising tags, and third-party content, seemingly harmless website tools can create serious privacy, security, and ePHI risks. On September 22 at 12 PM MT , learn where these risks commonly hide and get practical steps to identify, evaluate, and reduce your website-tracking risk before it becomes a compliance problem.

No Final Rule, No Excuse: Building HIPAA Security Readiness Now.

Join our FREE online webinar as HCP's Nicole Stately shares how HHS has pushed the final HIPAA Security Rule update to July 2027, but OCR's enforcement actions already show exactly where they expect covered entities and business associates to be today. This session breaks down the proposed changes, decodes recent settlements for early warning signs, and gives you a practical action list to close gaps now, before the rule (and the penalties) catch up to you.

Compliance Lessons from the Patient Journey

July 22, 2026

Join our FREE online webinar as HCP's Jake Yates shares his powerful patient journey after a routine surgery led to unexpected complications, multiple additional surgeries, and a 25-day hospital stay.

Through this firsthand experience, Jake gained a new perspective on the true purpose of compliance: protecting patients. Learn how compliance impacted his care, what mattered most from a patient's perspective, and how healthcare organizations can create a more patient-centered compliance program.

Healthcare Compliance for Small Practices: What You Can't Ignore in 2026

June 17, 2026

Join us as we break down the must-do compliance priorities for 2026. Learn how to focus limited resources on the highest-risk areas, prepare for increased audits and investigations, and keep your organization audit-ready without needing a full-time compliance department. We'll cover the top federal compliance risks organizations should be aware of, how the OIG's General Compliance Program Guide (GCPC) and recent enforcement trends apply in today's environment, ways to build a practical and right-sized compliance program, and 3-5 concrete action items you can prioritize over the next 90 days.

I Find Your Lack of Compliance Disturbing - Compliance Lessons Learned from Star Wars

May 4, 2026

Understanding compliance concepts and regulations can be an exhausting and dull process. While important, it can be frustrating and difficult to apply these essential concepts--especially to your workforce. Well, that's about to change! During this thrilling webinar, we'll examine compliance topics like never before! Using concepts and examples from the Star Wars ® film franchise, you will learn about the essential pieces of developing and maintaining an effective compliance program, including HIPAA, OSHA, and Corporate compliance. If you're struggling to find an entertaining way to educate yourself and your workforce on compliance topics, join this webinar for a fresh new take on compliance education. The Force will be with you as you learn how to make compliance engaging and fun.

See Your Risk Before Payers Do: Introducing SENTRY: Proactive Coding & Billing Intelligence.

Adam Laing and Kira Perez present an exclusive webinar introducing SENTRY, a coding intelligence solution that helps healthcare organizations identify risk, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen billing compliance. We'll cover current coding and billing challenges, show how SENTRY analyzes claims, identifies provider outliers, benchmarks performance, and supports continuous quarterly analytics, audits, and education, including a real client case study demonstrating improved visibility, performance, and audit readiness. Whether your focus is compliance, revenue integrity, or operational efficiency, this webinar will show how proactive coding intelligence keeps your organization ahead of risk.

MythBusters--Compliance Style

Did you know not all health information is protected by HIPAA? Or that only large healthcare organizations get investigated by the OCR? One of these is a myth and one is a confirmed fact. During this webinar we'll explore some of the most common myths in healthcare compliance. Join us as we explore each one--MythBusters style. (DISCLAIMER: No compliance officers were harmed in the making of this webinar.)"

Transforming Risk to Resilience.

In this webinar, we'll explore recent OCR cybersecurity guidance and proposed HIPAA Security Rule updates through a practical lens, showing how everyday decisions, policies, and habits shape your organization's overall security posture. Designed for the entire healthcare workforce, this session introduces seven foundational principles that demonstrate how small, intentional changes can strengthen resilience, reduce risk, and create a more unified approach to protecting patient information.

Compliance Resolutions: Fixing the Policy: Process Gap That Trips Practices Up

In this webinar, we explored why compliance feels so difficult to maintain , why concepts like required vs. addressable cause so much uncertainty, and how the gap between regulatory language and real-world workflows develops, regardless of whether a practice has robust policies, outdated ones, or none at all. If compliance feels like a moving target, this session will help you understand why, and what an effective compliance program is actually designed to do.

All I Want For Christmas Is HIPAA-Compliant Social Media!

In this webinar, we break down how to stay HIPAA-compliant while using social media, along with real-life examples of what can happen when the rules aren't followed. You'll learn which regulations apply, what to avoid, and how to protect your organization while still engaging online.

Webinar October 2025 - Spooky Tales: Learning from HIPAA Audits.

In this webinar, we explored how to survive the audit nightmare by uncovering what the OCR is really looking for during investigations. Attendees also learned how to bring their compliance programs back to life , with practical tips and real-world insights to strengthen policies, training, and audit readiness.

Webinar: September 2025: Come With Me, and You'll Be Free From a World of OSHA Violations.

Come with us as we embark on an exciting journey of OSHA compliance like you've never experienced it before! This webinar will focus on key areas of OSHA compliance by viewing them through the lens of the cinematic classic, Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory! This exhilarating webinar will take you on a whirlwind of OSHA compliance violations and prevention techniques using examples from the characters in the film. During the webinar we'll explore topics like: -Slips, Trips, and Falls -Workplace safety -Handling emergencies -Becoming an OSHA compliance winner And so much more! We invite you to come and enjoy this magical journey of OSHA Compliance!

Ransomware Data Breaches: What You Need to Know to Protect Your Business

Ransomware is one of the most dangerous threats facing healthcare organizations today, costing providers millions in fines, penalties, and lost patient trust. Recent breaches show that no practice is too small to be targeted, and failing to conduct a proper Security Risk Analysis is the #1 reason for penalties. In our latest webinar, Nicole Statley shows you how to strengthen your HIPAA compliance, protect patient data, and build a proactive defense against cyberattacks.

Don't Risk It: Why a Security Risk Analysis is Critical for ePHI Protection

The OCR is ramping up enforcement of the HIPAA Security Rule, and failure to complete a proper Security Risk Analysis (SRA) is landing organizations in serious trouble. In this webinar, we broke down what an SRA really involves, why it's more important than ever, and how to get it right.

What We Covered in This Webinar:

  • What makes an SRA "accurate and thorough" under HIPAA
  • How recent enforcement actions highlight growing risks
  • Steps your organization can take to strengthen ePHI security

Questions people ask first

How fast can we be up and running?

Most organizations are fully live in two to three weeks. Your advisor does the policy customization, staff roster and training assignment; your team spends about three hours in total.

Is any of this sold separately?

Most of it is part of a program rather than a product you buy alone. Tell an advisor what you already have in place and they will scope only the parts you are missing.

Twenty minutes with an advisor, then a written gap analysis for your own setting, ranked by what would actually hurt you first. The findings are yours whether or not you become a client.
